sourceAudit.scope: GLB headers, buffer/accessor bounds, source indices, finite values, increasing animation times, metadata and image decode. Not full animation playback, biological identification or rights authentication.

sourceLinks.rightsConclusion: Unresolved common-source provenance. Hold both adapted-output candidates. Not a finding of infringement, ownership or which licence is authoritative. A later restrictive upload does not automatically revoke a valid earlier permissive grant.
Possible source link, not proof of whole-asset copying. Review required because new BY-labelled input overlaps an earlier NC-labelled juvenile source.

nodeTests.coverage: Actual 19-source registry plus synthetic reviewed-permission cases. NC/ND/unknown/conflicted inputs remain held; coefficient fitting, recolouring, reparameterisation, child CC0 labels or self-authored flags do not detach ancestry. Missing/cyclic inputs are rejected. Permission reviews are hash-bound and BY needs attribution/change records. Independent work requires separate creation evidence. Inputs remain unchanged.
nodeTests.scope: Tests enforce project policy over declared lineage, not legal adjudication or discovery of omitted dependencies.

browserTests.scope: Data admission interface only; no WebGL, fish rendering, real device performance or public-workbench navigation.
